discrepancies: Chart Google flagship Jan 25 to Apr 25 at $0.40 (Gemini 2.0 Flash): not supported as the flagship. The Jan 31 2025 pricing page (https://web.archive.org/web/20250131021227id_/https://ai.google.dev/pricing) lists only 1.5 Flash ($0.30), 1.5 Flash-8B ($0.15), 1.5 Pro ($5.00, prompts up to 128k) and 1.0 Pro; Gemini 2.0 Flash was not yet priced (GA Feb 5 2025 per changelog). The flagship Pro-line price in Jan to May 2025 was $5.00 (1.5 Pro, GA). 2.0 Flash ($0.40) is a Flash-tier price; its page text in Feb 2025 calls it 'our most capable multi-modal model', which may be why it was treated as flagship. Gemini 2.0 Pro Experimental (Feb 5 2025) was free-only and never had a paid price.

Chart jumps to $10 from May 25 (2.5 Pro). The $10.00 price first appears Apr 4 2025 (2.5 Pro Preview with billing, changelog) and is visible in the May 2 2025 snapshot, so Apr 25 is $10 if previews count; as GA, 2.5 Pro (stable) arrived Jun 17 2025, so the GA-only series is $5.00 (1.5 Pro) through May 25 and $10.00 from Jun 25.

Chart stays $10 until Dec 25 and moves to $12 from Jan 26 (3.1 Pro). Gemini 3 Pro Preview was priced $12.00 from Nov 18 2025 (changelog and Nov 20 2025 snapshot), so $12 applies from Nov 25 if previews count. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (Feb 19 2026) is the same $12.00 and is still labelled Preview on the live page on Nov 18 2026, so no Gemini 3.x Pro ever reached GA; the GA-only Pro series stays at $10.00 (2.5 Pro) until Gemini 4 Argon.
Chart Oct 26 = $10 Gemini 4 Argon intro, steps to $20 on Dec 1: confirmed (Argon GA Oct 13 2026; $10.00 through Nov 30, $20.00 from Dec 1 2026; Nov 1 snapshot and live page).

Top tier name: on the live page (Nov 18 2026) Gemini 4 Carbon (GA Nov 10) is 'our most capable reasoning model' and Argon (GA Oct 13) is the 'efficient' Gemini 4 model, both at $10.00 intro then $20.00 from Dec 1. The Nov 1 snapshot (and changelog Oct 13) called Argon the flagship. Carbon, Neon ($15.00) and Hydrogen ($7.50) were all added Nov 10 to Nov 18 2026, after the last Wayback snapshot (Nov 1).

Chart note 'Gemini 3.x Flash promo $3.75': confirmed for Gemini 3.6, 3.7 and 3.8 Flash (intro $3.75 through Dec 31 2026, $7.50 from Jan 1 2027). Not true of Gemini 3.5 Flash ($9.00 from GA May 19 2026, no promo) nor Gemini 3.6 Flash at launch (Jul 21 2026 GA at $7.50 on the Aug 1 snapshot, $3.75 by Aug 18). Gemini 3 Flash Preview was $3.00 and 3.5 Flash-Lite $2.50.

Gemini 2.5 Pro is deprecated (changelog Nov 2 2026): from Dec 1 2026 requests route to Gemini 3.8 Flash and bill at its rates; gemini-2.5-flash routes to 3.5 Flash-Lite. The $10.00 Pro-line point for Nov 26 in the chart's old logic would be 2.5 Pro, but it is superseded by Gemini 4 Carbon/Argon at $10.00 intro.

Exact day Gemini 3.6 Flash dropped from $7.50 to the $3.75 intro price is between Aug 1 and Aug 18 2026, not pinned (probably tied to the Aug 13 Gemini 3.7 Flash launch, UNVERIFIED).
Gemini 4 Carbon (Nov 10), Hydrogen (Nov 12) and Neon (Nov 18) prices come from the live pricing page and changelog fetched Nov 18 2026; no archived snapshot exists after Nov 2 2026.
Mapping of Gemini 4 names to old tiers is a judgment: Argon/Carbon to Pro/flagship, Hydrogen to Flash (migration guide from 3.8 Flash), Neon unmapped; Google publishes no tier mapping.

Prices are text output for the standard paid tier at base context. Long-context rates exist (1.5 Pro above 128k $10.00; 2.5 Pro and 3.x Pro above 200k higher, not recorded). Priority and flex tiers on the 2026 pages show higher or lower multiples (e.g. 2.5 Pro $18.00 priority) and are excluded. Batch is half price and excluded.
